summary: Tested public API and mobile UI. Auth, business validation/save, keyword add, QR generation, public endpoints, draft generation API, logout, and cookie session behavior passed. Google login is explicitly unavailable as configured.

critical.issue: Always returns HTTP 501 because no Google client connection is configured; Google login button is non-functional by design.

integration_issues.issue: The browser run did not observe draft-item-0 within 20 seconds after clicking Generate; direct API generation completed successfully, so this may be the slow managed-LLM/fallback path and needs a longer wait/retest.

issues: App.css contains '..review-cards' instead of '.review-cards', so intended grid/gap/card styling is not applied to public draft cards.

action_items: Configure Emergent-managed Google login or clearly keep the feature marked unavailable; fix the public card CSS selector typo; retest generation UI with sufficient wait and inspect loading/error state.
critical_code_review_comments: Lifetime usage counter sums only currently returned active drafts, so deleted drafts are excluded and the value is not truly lifetime usage.
Reorder endpoint exists but no reorder control is exposed in the dashboard UI.
Generate can create another 20 drafts on every click without deduplication or usage safeguards.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable review-test-* and ui-test-unique-2@example.com owners and businesses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External preview URL tested. Direct API generation returned count 20 and 20 drafts. First UI run used login for a new account; second correctly registered, saved profile, added keyword, and rendered QR, but draft list was not observed within 20 seconds.
rca of the issue: Google limitation is explicit backend behavior at server.py:87-89 and frontend toast behavior at App.js:10. Public card styling failure is the extra leading dot in App.css:1 (..review-cards).
